To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed an automated sequential injection-differential pulse-voltammetric (SI- DPV) method based on a screen-printed carbon modified with carbon nanocomposites to analyze paraquat in water samples with high sensitivity and low cost.
a new method has been developed to determine the trace amount of paraquat based of the electrochemical behavior of the pesticide on the SPCE-CNT/Nfion modified electrode using the DPV technique.
the SPCE-CNT/Nf electrode was successfully used in the determination of paraquat in water samples.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new method for the determination of paraquat using a sequential injection-differential pulse system based on a screen-printed carbon modified with carbon nanofiber/Nafion.
the development of a new method for the sensitive determination of paraquath in water samples.
the development of a novel and highly sensitive SI-DPV system for the determination of paraquat based SPCE-CNT/Nf.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this method is very simple and rapid for the analysis of paraquat in real water samples.
the SPCE-CNT/Nf modified with CNT/Nafion is a very promising electrode for the trace analysis of paraquats in natural water samples.
the proposed system can be used as a rapid and simple technique for trace determination of paraquat in natural water and other matrices.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the developed method is a simple, rapid, and sensitive method for determination of paraquat in natural water samples.

the developed system has a good sensitivity and a good linear calibration graph with high tolerance to possible interferences and can be applied for analysis of paraquat in real samples without any pretreatment.
the SI-DPV based on SPCE modified with CNT/Nafion can be applied for determination of paraquat in real water samples with high sensitivity and selectivity.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a new method for the determination of paraquat based upon the differential pulse voltametry technique has been developed and the method has been successfully applied for analysis of paraquat in natural water samples.
the proposed SI-DPV system can be applied as a rapid, low cost, and sensitive method for the determination of paraquat in real samples.
the SPCE modified with CNT and Nafion can be used as a working electrode for the determination of paraquat in natural water and other environmental samples.
